snippet.title: FOXFIRE Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4714090/FOXFIRE/

Full Thrust, Full Inertia, Full Auto! 

FOXFIRE is a top-down sci-fi survivors-like with space physics and a devastating arsenal of evolving weaponry. Customize your ship and tear through alien swarms as routine recon missions descend into bullet hellscapes.
